test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

She said that she had already eaten her dinner.

options.text: She said, "I had already ate my dinner."
She said, "I have already eaten my dinner."
She said, "I am already eating my dinner."

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• She said, "I have already eaten my dinner. This option is the correct answer. 
 
• "It accurately reflects the conversion to indirect speech. 
 
• The** reported statement** is in the** past tense,** so the verb tense needs to be changed to past perfect ("had already eaten") to match. 
 
• The use of **"have"** in the reported statement is appropriate **when reporting** the** present perfect tense.**

Therefore the **correct answer** is- *She said, "I have already eaten my dinner."*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• * *Let's analyze all other options:
 
• She said, "I had already ate my dinner."
 
 
• This option is incorrect. The verb form "ate" is the past simple (v2) form, but the correct form in indirect speech is "had eaten," which is the past perfect form.
 
• The verb tense needs to be changed to match the reporting of past events.
 
 
 
• She said, "I had my dinner."
 
 
• This option is incorrect. It doesn't accurately convey the information from the original sentence.
 
• The phrase "I had my dinner" does not include the information that the dinner had already been eaten.
 
 
 
• She said, "I am already eating my dinner."
 
 
• This option is incorrect. The reported statement is in the past tense, so the verb tense needs to be changed to match.
 
• The phrase "I am already eating my dinner" does not accurately convey the information that the dinner had already been eaten.
